content.short: Aktionariat AG provides a digital solution to create markets for shares on company websites.
content.description: Aktionariat AG offers a digital solution that enables Swiss companies to establish markets for their shares directly on their own websites. By leveraging the Ethereum blockchain, it removes intermediaries and promotes open, liquid markets for securities that were previously illiquid. The approach aims to unlock liquidity and provide reliable pricing, delivering a meaningful price signal that can reveal value even when users do not plan to trade digital shares. It emphasizes on-chain visibility, transparent pricing, and scalable online access for issuing companies.
